fee_notes: Non-standard revenue-share model: franchisor retains 40% of Gross Margin (franchisee receives 60%) for temp staffing; 8% of Core/Healthcare Gross Receipts retained; 18% of Professional Direct Hire fees retained. Marketing fund: 0.6% of Gross Margin + 2% of Direct Hire/Search Fees. Tech base: $420/month EDN MRC + $210/month cloud = $630/month minimum; also $41.67/month ESP testing (Core only), $49.50/user/month, $8.28/workstation/month. Average effective royalty ~8.4% of gross sales per Item 19 Table 2.
